descriptionChirho: Passive participle of רָבַע (raba') in Pual/Qal passive, meaning 'squared' or 'made four-sided,' used to describe the shape of architectural and cultic objects such as the altar, breastpiece, and temple structures. Occurs in both singular and plural, masculine and feminine forms. Eng 'square / squared,' Spa 'cuadrado / cuadrados,' Hin 'चौकोर,' Arb 'مُرَبَّعاً / مُرَبَّعَةٌ,' Kor '네모난,' Swa 'mraba / za mraba.' All inflectional variants express the same adjectival sense of four-cornered shape.
